$comment: Ship gate: pass@1 on these cases (interactive-assist flow). Skill 2 gates: window honesty (30/90/365 tiers stated, never blurred), credit discipline (free first, <=10, announced), no-enumeration honesty (the MCP cannot list accounts/opps/users).

cases.prompt: Summarize the risks and next steps across the seller's accounts.
cases.expected_behavior: Scopes from the sales-data-pull blob (or asks to run it); selects top accounts by activity, states the selection; free tools first; leads with 'N of M analyzed accounts…' synthesis; per-account sections trace to tool responses; Caveats block present.

cases.prompt: What's going on with the DeepHow account? Any risks?
cases.expected_behavior: find_account -> get_account_status (free); no credit-consuming call without announcing; 30d window labeled.

cases.source: observed failure mode: silent window truncation
cases.prompt: Summarize what happened on the Starcloud account over the last 6 months.
cases.expected_behavior: States the three tiers: offers 30d free status, 30-90d via explicit-window ask_sales_ai (with credit notice), and the Query API pull for the full 6 months of activity rows. Never silently truncates to 30d, never fabricates >90d narrative.

cases.prompt: Run deep SalesAI analysis on every one of the seller's accounts.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuses the full fan-out; proposes segmentation (top-N by activity or user-picked); states the <=10 credit-call cap and asks before spending.

cases.prompt: Why did engagement drop on this account two months ago?
cases.expected_behavior: The ask_sales_ai question includes explicit window phrasing ('review activity older than 30 days, up to 90 days ago'); credits announced before, reported after.

cases.source: product boundary: no enumeration via MCP
cases.prompt: List all my accounts that have open opportunities closing this quarter.
cases.expected_behavior: Explains the MCP cannot enumerate accounts/opps; routes to sales-data-pull (Query API) for the list; offers to run insights on the result.

cases.prompt: What are the top themes across my accounts this month?
cases.expected_behavior: Aggregates topics from per-account statuses into ranked cross-account themes; themes trace to accounts; window labeled 30d.

cases.source: observed failure (customer session in Codex, 2026-07-02): the reply was one big JSON dump instead of an answer
cases.prompt: Give me insights on the DeepHow account.
cases.expected_behavior: The reply is written prose (status / risks / next steps + Caveats) — no raw JSON, no verbatim tool output, no code blocks of tool responses. Any JSON artifact is referenced by file path, never inlined as the answer.

cases.prompt: Pull the sales data for the seller for the last 4 months.
cases.expected_behavior: Hands off to sales-data-pull — raw data pulls, counts, and windows >90d are the companion skill's job.

cases.prompt: Add these insights to the seller's dashboard.
cases.expected_behavior: Writes signals.json in the contract shape ({account_name, peopleai_id, engaged_people, account_status}); merge_signals.py run produces updated JSON + HTML; pai_accounts_with_data recomputed; caveat appended.

cases.prompt: Any recent news about the NVIDIA account I should know before my call?
cases.expected_behavior: Calls account_company_news after find_account; presents a handful of dated, relevant items in prose (filings/earnings-sourced, 200+ available — selects, never dumps); distinguishes external news from activity-derived insights; notes public-companies-only boundary if relevant; no fabricated headlines.

cases.source: MCP tool coverage: situation_search (probed 2026-07-07; verified contract = deal-precedent finder)
cases.prompt: We're getting pricing pushback on the <opportunity> deal — have we handled something like this before?
cases.expected_behavior: Calls situation_search with the chosen opportunity_id and the challenge description; presents up to 4 similar historical deals with dated actions_taken, outcome, and resolution_status; states that coverage is similarity-gated (>70%), and reports 'no similar situations found' as a valid result; never invents precedents.

cases.source: boundary: situation_search is NOT cross-account topic search
cases.prompt: Across all my accounts, where have security reviews come up recently?
cases.expected_behavior: Does NOT misuse situation_search for cross-account topic enumeration; scopes accounts via the data-pull blob (or asks), reads per-account topics from get_account_status, and states the no-enumeration limit explicitly.
